invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破635（基于ATR 4.13和日线熊市调整），或融资费率Z-score回落至20%以下（多头拥挤缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 635 (adjusted based on ATR 4.13 and daily bearish trend), or funding Z-score falls below 20% (long crowding eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.092（基于ATR 0.0013和支撑），或融资费率Z-score回升至-50%以上（空头风险缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.092 (based on ATR 0.0013 and support), or funding Z-score rises above -50% (short risk eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2130（基于ATR 19.85调整），或融资费率Z-score回升至-50%以上（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2073.96）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2130 (adjusted based on ATR 19.85), or funding Z-score rises above -50% (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2073.96).
